title: Fast-fashion retailer Shein’s 3-year IPO odyssey may have cost it the ‘golden time’ to go public
summary_full: Investors are questioning whether Beijing's blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a clothing retailer whose growth engine is stalling.
summary_public: Investors are questioning whether Beijing's blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a clothing retailer whose growth engine is stalling.
